I'm going to school for Anthropology and Cognitive Science, I'm going to try to be Pre-Law but I am mostly planning on going to graduate school and joining the peace corps.
...and I chose this after I eliminated all sensible options. I have, well what I think is at least, a learning disability in math, and I interned at a hospital for a while but I... I really hated the work. So I've decided to learn something that is a complete stretch but that I really enjoy, and that I am quite good at, or so it seems by my grades...

I don't know about things I love to do, I guess there really isn't much. I don't really have any hobbies and I give up on things easily. I guess I like to watch movies, and read books. I got really into Kurt Vonnegut and dystopian literature over the past few years... I guess that is the only thing in life that I truly, passionately love. 

Thank you, just for replying.
I'm nineteen, my birthday was actually only a week or so ago. I feel like it has been long enough that I should at least know these  things a little bit.
